name: LEGO DREAMZzz
description: A group of kids join a secret agency where they learn to use the power of imagination to journey into the Dream World and create fantastic creations in order to help sleeping children being terrorized by the evil Nightmare King who is bent on conquering the Dream World and invading the Waking World.

videos.title: I Just Had the Weirdest Dream
videos.overview:
It’s another day at the Monastery of Spinjitzu in the world of NINJAGO. Yet, something feels different…

Having just awakened from his slumber Kai remembers the weirdest dream. He attempts to tell the others but describing how he flew through the landscape on a bunny creature just doesn’t make sense when said out loud.

Ninja do dream, but this was different. Something strange is coming.

videos.title: I Just Had the Most Wonderful Dream
videos.overview:
It’s another day at the Monastery of Spinjitzu in the world of NINJAGO. Yet, something feels different…

What a great way to start the day! Nya has just had the most wonderful dream running freely with the most fantastic creatures in a field on … a flying island?

Ninja do dream, but this was different. Something wonderful is coming.

videos.title: I Just Had the Most Peculiar Dream
videos.overview:
It’s another day at the Monastery of Spinjitzu in the world of NINJAGO. Yet, something feels different…

What a way to wake up! Zane has just had the most peculiar dream about flying through a dream realm transit causing him to fall out of his bed. Ninja do dream, but this was different. Something peculiar is coming!

Stay tuned to discover the world of your wildest dreams.

videos.title: I Just Had the Most Outrageous Dream
videos.overview:
It’s another day at the Monastery of Spinjitzu in the world of NINJAGO. Yet, something feels different…

It seems like a normal day in the village, but Master Wu has just had the most outrageous dream. Something about a candy land, a giant chicken and… vehicles merged with animals…?!

Ninja do dream, but this was different. Something outrageous is coming.

videos.title: Dream chasers to the rescue
videos.overview: Our tired heroes recount a “safe” version of their weekend activities when a rather nosy classmate asks them what they’ve been up to.

videos.title: Welcome to a world of dreams
videos.overview: Mateo and his sister Izzie might be living in an ordinary city where they are ordinary students in an ordinary school. But they are no ordinary kids. When they dream, they go to the dream world to live out awesome adventures and fight off evil.

videos.title: Draw Bunchu with Mateo
videos.overview: In this tutorial, Mateo takes you through the process of drawing the dream world version of Izzie’s bunny plushie, Bunchu.

videos.title: Draw Z-Blob with Mateo
videos.overview: Mateo takes you through the process of drawing his very own goo-based shape-shifting creation, Z-Blob.

videos.title: Draw Night Hunter with Mateo
videos.overview: Mateo takes you through the process of drawing the evil Night Hunter who’s the most trusted general of the Nightmare King.

videos.title: Draw Croc Car with Mateo
videos.overview: Mateo takes you through the process of drawing the awesome Croc Car.

videos.title: Draw Zoey with Mateo
videos.overview: Matoe takes you through the process of drawing the intriguing and cool character of Zoey.

videos.title: Draw Zian with Mateo
videos.overview: Mateo takes you through the process of drawing the giant Cat-Owl gryphon, Zian.

videos.title: Draw Landscape with Mateo
videos.overview: Mateo takes you through the process of drawing the beautiful landscapes of the dream realms.

videos.title: Draw Explosions with Mateo
videos.overview: Mateo takes you through the process of drawing epic and realistic explosions to bring some action to your adventure.

videos.title: Logan’s Training Tutorials E1 – Ready to begin your training?
videos.overview: Logan is sharing awesome tips with you in his Totally Terrific Dream Chaser Training Tutorials! In this first episode, you’ll see Mateo and Izzie in action, meet a frightening Grimkeeper and learn how to navigate exciting dream realms!

videos.title: Logan’s Training Tutorials E2 – There’s no creature I can’t train!
videos.overview: Logan has trained Z-Blob to box, he’s taught Mr. Sharkyjaw to fight off Grimspawn, and now he’s here to train you with his Totally Terrific Dream Chaser Training Tutorials! Watch the 2nd episode to find out how to escape from a Grimkeeper’s cage and what to do when a nightmare appears in the waking world!

videos.title: Logan’s Training Tutorials E3 – Buckle up, guys!
videos.overview: Check out Logan’s latest Totally Terrific Dream Chaser Training Tutorial to see Coop dream craft a giant tire and get top tips on staying safe while riding a space school bus! Here’s a clue – you’re going to need to fasten your seatbelt!

videos.title: Logan’s Training Tutorials E4 – Escaping Grimspawn 101
videos.overview: Logan’s here to help you escape Grimspawn with his latest Totally Terrific Dream Chaser Training Tutorial! Check it out to see the Loganator rocking an awesome helmet, Mr. Oz and Albert battling Grimspawn and Zoey saving the day with her sidekick Zian!

videos.title: Logan’s Training Tutorials E5 – Discover exciting dream crafts!
videos.overview: Journey into an exciting new realm in Logan’s latest Totally Terrific Dream Chaser Training Tutorial! Here, Izzie dream crafts Bunchu into a giant and Coop dream crafts an awesome car. But which is faster? Watch the video to find out!

videos.title: Logan’s Training Tutorials E6 – Enter the Night Bureau!
videos.overview: Step into the Night Bureau with Logan’s latest Totally Terrific Dream Chaser Training Tutorial! Here, you’ll find loads of cool trinkets that Mr. Oz has collected throughout his years as a Dream Chaser, including a nifty gadget that reveals your strongest memory or most recent dream. Check it out!

videos.title: Logan’s Training Tutorials E7 – Welcome to Nimbus Infinite!
videos.overview: Discover the coolest game in the dream world – Nimbus Infinite! Want to become an elite player? Check out the latest episode of Logan’s Totally Terrific Dream Chaser Training Tutorials to find out how!

videos.title: Logan’s Training Tutorials E8 – School…but in a dream!
videos.overview: Dreaming about school sounds a little boring…but nothing is boring in the dream world! Check out the latest episode of Logan’s Totally Terrific Dream Chaser Training Tutorials to find out how dream world school is different!

videos.title: Logan’s Training Tutorials E9 – Logan vs. Sneak!
videos.overview: Sneak is being sneaky (as usual) and it’s making Logan mad! Watch this episode of Logan’s Totally Terrific Dream Chaser Training Tutorials to find out what happens when Logan gets angry. Spoiler alert: he turns a very cool color!

videos.title: Logan’s Training Tutorials E10 – The Dream Chasers are in danger!
videos.overview: The Dream Chasers are being hunted by a wolf and they have no magical accessories! How will they get out of this sticky situation? Watch this episode of Logan’s Totally Terrific Dream Chaser Training Tutorials to find out. Clue – Logan’s very first dream craft might be involved! You definitely don’t want to miss this...

videos.title: Dreamolition Duo vs. The Mutated Math Monsters
videos.overview: It seems like just another day in algebra class when disaster strikes. When rad radiation soda spills on the board, mutated math monstrosities are unleashed! Who knew math could be so evil?!

videos.title: Dreamolition Duo vs. The Shocker Ball
videos.overview: Coach Jefferies’ pop quiz is taking the fun out of PE class until a demonic soccer ball attacks! With an unstoppable hunger and the power to double in size, this may be the Dreamolition Duo’s biggest challenge yet!

videos.title: Dreamolition Duo vs. The Pyro-Maniacs!
videos.overview: When Z-Blob accidentally sets a science quiz on fire, he gives rise to the mischievous pyro-maniacs. These fiery creatures blaze a trail of chaos, turning everything in their path into an inferno. With their numbers multiplying, their evil master Firecracker reveals himself and his plans to reduce the entire school to smoldering ashes.

videos.title: Dreamolition Duo vs. The Pudding Pirates
videos.overview: In an explosive encounter, our valiant explorers are left marooned and circled by hungry sharks. When the Pudding Pirates get away with the treasure map, it’s up to M-Man and Z-Blob to save the crew.

videos.title: Dreamolition Duo vs. The Banana Bandit
videos.overview: M-Man and Z-Blob make the courageous decision to retrieve the stolen fruit. They plunge into the pages of the art book and embark on an extraordinary journey through famous artworks, hot on the trail of the elusive thief.

videos.title: Dreamolition Duo vs. The Teenage Kung-Fu Vampire Hamster
videos.overview: When the class hamster gets blasted by lightning and bitten by a vampire bat, she turns into a Teenage Kung-Fu Vampire Hamster! Being forced to run on her wheel every day has made her bloodthirsty for revenge.

videos.title: Dreamolition Duo vs. The Calamitous Cat Curse and the Menacing Mummies!
videos.overview: When King Oz’s ancient Egyptian curse turns Mateo’s classmates into cats, it’s up to the Dreamolition Duo to save the day.

videos.title: Dreamolition Duo vs. The Zombie Students
videos.overview: When Mr. Oz’s boring lecture triggers a bizarre change in the brain chemistry of his class, the students begin to turn into mindless zombies! As the zombie infection spreads, M-Man and Z-Blob are forced to do battle with their former classmates.

videos.title: Dreamolition Duo vs. The Big, Bad, Bionic, BEAThoven!
videos.overview: When Bionic BEAThoven crashes a music class, he is angered by the student’s poor knowledge of his music. Determined to teach them a lesson, he proposes some harsh punishments.

videos.title: Dreamolition Duo vs. The Slimy Scary Space Saturnians
videos.overview: When aliens from Pluto abduct Mr. Oz, M-Man and Z-Blob blast off into space in hot pursuit. Ready to confront the Plutonians, our dynamic duo discover the aliens need Mr. Oz’s help to save them from the evil Saturnians who are enslaving their race.

videos.title: Z-Blob in Left Alone Part I
videos.overview: Ready for a crazy, green, bouncing bundle of mayhem? Z-Blob’s appetite is as big as his sense of adventure, and when Mateo isn't looking, he’s ready for action, and boy, does he find it.

videos.title: Z-Blob in Left Alone Part II
videos.overview: Brace yourselves! Z-Blob is back for another round of mischief. With an appetite that's as big as his thirst for adventure, your favourite bouncing green bundle of trouble is all set to stir up more chaos!

videos.title: Z-Blob in Left Alone Part III
videos.overview: Left alone with a bicycle and some pencils, Z-Blob turns the ordinary into extraordinary antics.

videos.title: Mr. Oz Explains | Meet Zian
videos.overview:
Looking to get a little closer to the dream chaser gang? Join Mr. Oz as he gives you the perfect introduction…

Meet Zian! Part owl, part cat – a creature so beautiful and magnificent that only the dream world could produce him. Forever patrolling the skies, he’s Zoey’s loyal companion and always ready to save dreamers in distress.

videos.title: Mr. Oz Explains | Meet Zoey
videos.overview:
Looking to get a little closer to the dream chaser gang? Join Mr. Oz as he gives you the perfect introduction…

Meet Zoey –– AKA the dream bandit! She’s independent, mysterious, and a crack shot with her bow. In the dream world, Zoey has the power to control time and can often be found flying with her loyal companion Zian. Don’t get on her bad side though, she isn’t afraid of ruffling a few feathers.

videos.title: Mr. Oz Explains | Meet the Night Hunter
videos.overview:
Need some intel on the Nightmare King’s forces? Join Mr. Oz as he gives you the lowdown on those who lurk in the Grim Realm...

Meet the Night Hunter! As the Nightmare King’s right-hand man, he commands the Grimspawn and Grimkeepers and is always looking for new ways to trouble the Night Bureau. Watch out for his cross-bow – the arrows may corrupt you!

videos.title: Mr. Oz Explains | Meet the Grimkeepers
videos.overview:
Need some intel on the Nightmare King’s forces? Join Mr. Oz as he gives you the lowdown on those who lurk in the Grim Realm...

Meet the Grimkeepers! These scary guys are the walking prisons that the Nightmare King uses to bring captured dreamers to The Shadowkeep. We don’t know where they came from, but one thing’s for sure – you’ll want to stay out of their way!

videos.title: Mr. Oz Explains | Meet Mateo
videos.overview:
Looking to get a little closer to the dream chaser gang? Join Mr. Oz as he gives you the perfect introduction…

Meet Mateo! Blessed with a natural gift for creativity, he’s always drawing and telling stories, but can lack a little confidence in his own abilities. However, with his trusty sidekick Z-Blob by his side, Mateo is capable of almost anything he sets his mind to!

videos.title: Mr. Oz Explains | Meet Izzie
videos.overview: Meet Izzie! What an energy ball! Not your typical Night Bureau agent but Izzie's a very valuable addition to the dream chasers. She’s completely fearless! Well, mostly. She dives head-first into action with little regard for her own safety. Not exactly a great strategist but she gets results!

videos.title: Mr. Oz Explains | Meet Cooper
videos.overview: Meet Cooper! He’s an A-student, a fine athlete, and loves building model cars. But he’s very logical, so his dream crafts aren’t very imaginative – yet! Luckily, he’s got the other dream chasers and they could teach him something valuable! I can’t wait to see what he dream crafts when he learns to add some wild  creativity!

videos.title: Mr. Oz Explains | Meet Bunchu
videos.overview: Meet Bunchu! Izzie’s wonderous big blue bunny that she dream crafts from her favorite plushie. He’s a direct extension of Izzie’s personality – impulsive, eager, and wild, haha! They make a great team. And as her abilities grow, I’m sure she’ll dream craft him in many different ways!

videos.title: Mr. Oz Explains | Meet the Grimspawn
videos.overview: Meet the Grimspawn! The Nightmare King's endless supply of nasty lackeys created from the corrupted imaginations of dreamers! They are truly terrible. It's best if you avoid them altogether. Especially Snivel, Sneak, and Susan, the Night Hunter's closest henchmen...

videos.title: Mr. Oz Explains | Meet Logan
videos.overview: Meet Logan! He isn’t exactly in touch with his imagination yet, but this kid has got attitude! His emotions give him a real edge in the dream world – they seem to strengthen the others' dream crafting! I wonder what his full potential is as he becomes a master of his emotions!

videos.title: Night Hunter Rants | The ‘Truth’ about Mateo
videos.overview: Muhaha, I knew you'd come. I am the Night Hunter, and you’re here for dark knowledge.  Let’s start with that oddball Mateo. He may have an imagination, but he isn’t going to win any personality contests. Oz says nothing will hold him back once he embraces who he is, but that’s a load of nightmare dung! Mateo and his friends are no match for the Nightmare King.

videos.title: Night Hunter Rants | Cooper the Pooper
videos.overview:
I knew you’d be back, muhaha. You couldn’t resist the darkness. And I, the Night Hunter, have more knowledge to enlighten you with…

What’s that kid called? The bland dream chaser. I think it rhymes with pooper… That's it, COOPER! Smart, respects authority, and gets along with everyone. YAWN! How boring. I’d have ditched him long ago. We’ll lock Cooper up again and, this time, there’ll be no escape!

videos.title: Night Hunter Rants | Izzie’s Flaws
videos.overview: Back so soon? As the Night Hunter, I see it’s in your nature to seek out darkness and danger!  Izzie may be fearless, but she has three major flaws that can be exploited! She always acts before she thinks, loves all animals and dream creatures, and will protect her family at all costs. Mr. Oz would say that makes her strong, but everyone knows the ones you love can easily be used against you, muhaha!

videos.title: Night Hunter Rants | Logan WILL be Corrupted
videos.overview:
Back for more? Muhaha, I knew you would be because I am the Night Hunter!

You know, I can’t stand most dream chasers – insufferable fools! But Logan? He has potential. You can just tell he is DYING to join our side. It won’t take much to corrupt him. If there’s one thing the Nightmare King values, it’s a bad attitude. It's only a matter of time before Logan joins our dark army, muhaha!

videos.title: Night Hunter Rants | Oswald the Failure
videos.overview:
Look who’s back seeking darkness and danger. Well, let’s see what I, the Night Hunter, can enlighten you with today…

Ahh, my old friend Oswald! He thinks he’s an expert in the dream world, but he’s just a washed-up science teacher. I heard he only got his band of rejects together by accident – what a failure! I’ll let you in on a little secret: Mr. Oz, the Nightmare King, and I have what you could call… history, muhaha!

videos.title: Night Hunter Rants | Let’s Turn Z-Blob AGAINST Mateo
videos.overview:
I see you’ve returned for more knowledge from me, the Night Hunter. Let me enlighten you...

Eurgh, that little snot ball, Z-Blob. How disgusting. If you were going to bring something to life in the dream world, wouldn’t you pick something more exciting than a wobbly pickle with eyes? I don’t see the appeal. I’m more interested in how we can use Z-Blob AGAINST Mateo, muhaha!

videos.title: Night Hunter Rants | Zoey the Loner
videos.overview:
Welcome back. I, the Night Hunter, will gladly enlighten you with dark knowledge to use for something sinister!

Ahh, Zoey. Delivery girl by day, dream bandit by night. A real loner. If you want to take her down, you'll have to mess with Zian, that flying thing that never leaves her side, OR Mrs. Castillo! Oh, and you know that tune I whistle in an oh-so-ominous way?  I stole it from Zoey and hearing me whistle it gets her all riled up! It’s only a matter of time before she slips up, muhaha.

videos.title: Night Hunter Rants | Bunchu – Fluffy-Tailed Abomination
videos.overview:
Back so soon? I, the Night Hunter, will enlighten you about Izzie’s floppy-eared monstrosity!

Have you ever seen anything as revolting as Bunchu? He’s a fluffy-tailed abomination! Seriously, dream craft something worth our time! He’ll soon meet the same fate as Mr. Sharkyjaw. Mark my words, Bunchu will NOT live hoppily ever after...

videos.title: Night Hunter Rants | Fear Fuels the Night Hunter
videos.overview:
Muhaha, look who’s back seeking darkness and danger. Well, let’s see what I, the Night Hunter, can enlighten you with today...

Hmm, what about the Nightmare King's second in command – ME! I oversee our dark army and capture dreamers and dream creatures. There's nothing like spreading fear and messing with Oswald and his band of misfits to get the blood flowing! Join forces with us now so you don't find yourself on the wrong side of history!

videos.title: Night Hunter Rants | How Terrifying is the Nightmare King?
videos.overview:
I see you’ve returned, muhaha. Back for more knowledge from me, the Night Hunter.

We can’t forget his mighty ghoulishness, the Nightmare King! He’s the very reason I do what I do. His ghastliness taught me that nightmares haunt you forever, and he even created an awesome army of bloodcurdling creatures to prove it, muhaha! If I’m being honest, he sometimes even scares me...

videos.title: Night Hunter Rants | The Best Thing Grimspawn Can Do? Terrorize Dreamers!
Night Hunter Rants | Corrupting Mr. Sharkyjaw
videos.overview:
Back again already? Muhaha, I’m not surprised. The Night Hunter is here to share darkness and danger with you.

Corrupting Izzie’s favorite plushie, Mr. Sharkyjaw, was a real coup. It dealt the dream chasers a devastating blow, especially Izzie – she goes to pieces every time she sees the new and IMPROVED Mr. Sharkyjaw. But he isn’t the only plushie I have my eye on, muhaha!

videos.title: Night Hunter Rants | Here Come the Night Terrors
videos.overview:
Welcome back, muhaha! Ready for more knowledge from me, the Night Hunter? Let me enlighten you…

Ooh Night Terrors, I love those bad beauties. They make your worst nightmare seem tame! There’s nothing more awe-inspiring than a flock of Night Terrors swooping the skies. The sight alone is enough to force terrified dreamers awake. And when they do… LEBAM! Watch out waking world, here comes a Night Terror attack, muhaha!

videos.title: Night Hunter Rants | Grimkeepers
videos.overview:
Muhaha, I knew you’d come. The Night Hunter is ready to share more dark knowledge with you.

Ahh, Grimkeepers: terrifying, ugly as sin, and a pleasure to work with. They may not be the sharpest tools, but they do an excellent job of scaring the pants off dreamers. Muhaha, I can’t tell you how many times I’ve seen a dreamer faint at the mere sight of one!

videos.title: Night Hunter Rants | Zian the Flying Cat Menace
videos.overview:
Back so soon? Let’s see what I, the Night Hunter, can enlighten you with today...

I don’t know how Zoey befriended her ridiculous pet, Zian, but it’s infuriating how he always swoops in to save Mr. Oz and his band of losers. What is he anyway?! A cat with wings? An owl with a tail? Who knows. But one thing is for sure, that fleabag is a big thorn in my side!

videos.title: Mr. Oz Explains | Meet the Nightmare King
videos.overview:
Need some intel on the Nightmare King’s forces? Join Mr. Oz as he gives you the lowdown on those who lurk in the Grim Realm...

Meet the Nightmare King himself! He has escaped his prison and is growing his nightmare army by stealing dreamers’ imaginations. He is hellbent on corrupting and ruling the dream world, but his interest in Lunia’s hourglass suggests he has even greater ambitions!

videos.title: Mr. Oz Explains | Meet Mr. Oz
videos.overview:
Looking to get a little closer to the dream chaser gang? Join Mr. Oz as he introduces himself…

Meet Mr. Oz! Science teacher by day, agent of the Night Bureau by night. As head of the Brooklyn branch of the Night Bureau, Mr. Oz is ready to bring it back to its former glory with the help of the gang. He believes by working together, they can defeat the Nightmare King!

videos.title: Mr. Oz Explains | Meet the Night Terrors
videos.overview:
Need some intel on the Nightmare King’s forces? Join Mr. Oz as he gives you the lowdown on those who lurk in the Grim Realm...

Meet the Night Terrors! These foul, shadow-like creatures are surely the worst the nightmares have to offer. With a fearsome special ability to cross over to the waking world, the best piece of advice is to avoid them at all costs!

videos.title: Mr. Oz Explains | Meet Mr. Sharkyjaw
Mr. Oz Explains | Meet Z-Blob
videos.overview:
Looking to get a little closer to the dream chaser gang? Join Mr. Oz as he gives you the perfect introduction...

Meet Z-Blob! Mateo’s green blobby comic creation and best friend – they’re inseparable. Mateo often bases his dream crafts on Z-Blob, turning him into a chopper or a giant knight.  But what makes Z-Blob truly special is he can cross over from the dream world to the waking world!

videos.title: Logan's Training Tutorials | Episode 11
videos.overview:
Wicky wicky whasssaap dawgs! It’s me, Logan. Welcome back to my totally terrific dream chaser training tutorials and boy, do I have a doozy for you today!

One of the most important rules about any dream world mission is you must always have a handsome leader to lead you… like me! But if you don’t, I’ll show you what to do if you find yourself backed into a corner. I hope you learn something, noobs!

videos.title: Insomniac Club Nightmare Conspiracy Series | Heed the Call! Face the Truth!
videos.overview: I’m your host, Nova Patel, and THIS is the Insomniacs Club! Listen up and heed the call! Everyone in school is having nightmares and we’re here to unravel the truth behind this mind-muddling mystery. We have three popular theories: ALIENS! The cafeteria meatloaf. And my personal favorite, a shadowy group of dream agents. But don’t be afraid because the Insomniacs won’t rest until we find the truth.

videos.title: Insomniac Club Nightmare Conspiracy Series | The Whistler in the Mist
videos.overview: I’m your host, Nova Patel, and THIS is the Insomniacs Club! You know that relentless tune that chases you in your dreams? Well, it comes from who we call the SHADOW CHASER! Who is he? What does he want? Is he the one invading students’ dreams? Rest assured, the Insomniac Club WILL get to the bottom of this!

videos.title: Insomniac Club Nightmare Conspiracy Series | The Belly of the Beast
videos.overview: I’m your host, Nova Patel, and THIS is the Insomniacs Club! Have you been chased by the caged beasts? These monstrous masses of malice have prisons as torsos which they throw kids into! WHY are they doing that?! Where are they taking dreaming kids? Fret not, the Insomniacs won’t rest until we’ve found the truth!

videos.title: Insomniac Club Nightmare Conspiracy Series | New Campaign Initiatives
videos.overview: I’m your host, Nova Patel, and THIS is the Insomniacs Club! It’s painfully evident that we need to double our efforts and spread the word more! A massive poster and flyer campaign, on-the-ground staff, AND our eye-catching leaflets! You deserve a safe night’s sleep, people, and the Insomniacs will make sure you get it.

videos.title: Insomniac Club Nightmare Conspiracy Series | Rotten Rowdy Rascals
videos.overview: I’m your host, Nova Patel, and THIS is the Insomniacs Club! There’s nothing fun about nightmares, especially if you run into those rotten rowdy rascals. BUT you can’t have nightmares if you don’t sleep, right?! The solution? RAAAD Radioactive. No sleep, no suffering!

videos.title: Insomniac Club Nightmare Conspiracy Series | Imposters Among Us!
videos.overview: I’m your host, Nova Patel, and THIS is the Insomniacs Club! We have ruled out the cafeteria meatloaf and aliens as the cause of our nightmares. That leaves us with just one theory – there are imposters among us! The Insomniacs have long suspected this. Well, conspirators, know this: WE ARE ON TO YOU!

videos.title: Insomniac Conspiracy Club | Exposure and Evidence!
videos.overview: Have you experienced nightmares in the waking world? You aren’t alone! Join the leader of the Insomniac Conspiracy Club, Nova Patel, as she reveals some shocking evidence that PROVES nightmares walk among us! Where do they come from and what do they want?! Tune in to find out, as you should.

videos.title: Insomniac Conspiracy Club | Fall Festival! FALL OF EVERYTHING!!!
videos.overview: This year’s Fall Festival theme has been determined: FUN, FEAR, AND FESTIVITIES! Nova shares a stark warning to everyone planning to attend this year’s Fall Festival – stay at home, lock all doors and windows, and turn on all the lights to avoid the fearsome creatures of Nightmare Dimension X!

videos.title: Diary of a Dream Bandit | Episode 1 | Gryphon Kibble
videos.overview: When I discovered the dream world was real, I knew someone would have to keep it safe. And that someone was me – the Dream Bandit. After stopping in the Candy Realm to get Zian his gryphon kibble (even though it was my night off), I knew something was wrong. Dreamers were having fun until the Night Hunter decided to show up and ruin it! Dream Bandit to the rescue.

videos.title: Diary of a Dream Bandit | Episode 2 | Time Flies
videos.overview: In the dream world, second chances are hard to come by. But with my time-bending pocket watch, I’m always ready to put things right. It took a little practice learning how it worked... okay, A LOT of practice. But, as the saying goes, if at first you don’t succeed, try, try again!

videos.title: Diary of a Dream Bandit | Episode 3 | Stealth Mode
videos.overview:
So, you wanna know what it takes to be the Dream Bandit? Well, it’s not for the faint-hearted...

It requires a specific set of crafty skills and a willingness to make things right, no matter where you are in the dream world. Stealth mode activated!

videos.title: Diary of a Dream Bandit | Episode 4 | Midnight Jam
videos.overview: Being the Dream Bandit is not easy. When the Night Hunter corrupted my mom’s lullaby, I was angry and ready to settle the score. But sometimes you’ve got to set aside your personal grudges for a higher purpose. The dream world deserves a guardian – and I am that guardian!

videos.title: Diary of a Dream Bandit | Episode 5 | Babysitters’ Club
videos.overview:
Being a Dream Bandit isn’t all fortune, glory, and high adventure...sometimes it means babysitting!

The dream world is full of wacky creatures and people, and it wouldn’t be the same without them. That’s why I do what I do. I stick up for the little guy...and sometimes the big guy too! So, you can count on me to be here night after night, keeping an eye on all of them.

videos.title: Diary of a Dream Bandit | Episode 6 | Friends in High Places
videos.overview:
Being the Dream Bandit was always a solo operation... until I met Zian. At first, he was all claws and growls, exactly the kind of dream creature you do NOT want to mess with. But looks can be deceiving...

Not everything in the dream world is always as it seems. It pays to look a little closer because sometimes you’ll find something you never even realized you wanted... or needed.

videos.title: Snivel, Sneak & Susan in: Bone Brawl
videos.overview:
Join Snivel, Sneak & Susan as they do what Grimspawn do best – cause mischief and mayhem!

The mischievous trio have set their sights on a daring heist – stealing a Grimwolf’s bone while it sleeps. But when the Grimwolf wakes up, they’re in trouble! Will Snivel, Sneak & Susan be able to hold onto their prize, or will they be outsmarted?

videos.title: Snivel, Sneak & Susan in: Clash of Candy
videos.overview:
Join Snivel, Sneak & Susan as they do what Grimspawn do best – cause mischief and mayhem!

Snivel and Susan entertain themselves by stealing Sneak’s candy ball and teasing him. But when Sneak reveals his secret weapon, a can of Rad Radioactive, will it be him who has the last laugh?

videos.title: Snivel, Sneak & Susan in: Flight of Follies
videos.overview:
Join Snivel, Sneak & Susan as they do what Grimspawn do best – cause mischief and mayhem!

Snivel challenges Sneak & Susan to a race, and when he wins, he taunts them. Annoyed, they decide to teach Snivel a lesson, but it backfires and all chaos breaks loose! It’s a Grimspawn showdown – who will be victorious?

videos.title: Snivel, Sneak & Susan in: Heavy Weight Unboxing
videos.overview:
Join Snivel, Sneak & Susan as they do what Grimspawn do best – cause mischief and mayhem!

The tricksy trio join forces to unlock a mysterious box. With rocks, fists, and even their heads, they give it their all! Will they be able to resist their urge to squabble to get the prize?

videos.title: Snivel, Sneak & Susan in: Hiccup Hijinks
videos.overview:
Join Snivel, Sneak & Susan as they do what Grimspawn do best – cause mischief and mayhem!

Sneak’s got a serious case of the hiccups! But when Snivel and  Susan’s friendly efforts fail to cure him, they kick it up a notch with some mischievous moves!

videos.title: Snivel, Sneak & Susan in: Hide ‘N Sneak
videos.overview:
Join Snivel, Sneak & Susan as they do what Grimspawn do best – cause mischief and mayhem!

During a game of hide and seek, Sneak is nowhere to be found. Snivel and Susan pair up to find him but the game takes an unexpected turn as they stumble across giant plushies  everywhere! Can they escape their fluffy foes and find Sneak?

videos.title: Snivel, Sneak & Susan in: Hot Dog Battle
videos.overview:
Join Snivel, Sneak & Susan as they do what Grimspawn do best – cause mischief and mayhem!

Snivel and Sneak go head-to-head in a hot dog-eating contest. But when Snivel starts to lose, he cooks up a plan to snatch victory from the jaws of Sneak! Who will be crowned the ultimate hot dog champion?

videos.title: Snivel, Sneak & Susan in: Music Mash
videos.overview:
Join Snivel, Sneak & Susan as they do what Grimspawn do best – cause mischief and mayhem!

Snivel and Susan make a magical musical duo as they play enchanting music together. Feeling left out, Sneak tries to join in, but he just can’t hit the right note! Will he find his musical talent?

videos.title: Snivel, Sneak & Susan in: Running Wild
videos.overview:
Join Snivel, Sneak & Susan as they do what Grimspawn do best – cause mischief and mayhem!

The mischievous trio wreak havoc, scaring unicorns for fun. But when the unicorns take off with Snivel, Sneak and Susan on their tail, fun is replaced with fear! Can the Grimspawn find a way off this wild ride?

videos.title: Snivel, Sneak & Susan in: Untethered
videos.overview:
Join Snivel, Sneak & Susan as they do what Grimspawn do best – cause mischief and mayhem!

Sneak finds a tetherball and quickly masters the game. Annoyed he's having so much fun, Snivel and  Susan take over and turn it into a wild contest. Though pushed out, will Sneak be the one to have the last laugh?

videos.title: LEGO DREAMZzz x Ninjago - Dream Team
videos.overview: The ninja are on a mission. Everything is going well until strange things start happening.

videos.title: Awakening
videos.overview: Mateo and Izzie's dream becomes reality when Z-Blob, a comic book hero, comes alive. But when Cooper gets trapped by Dream World creatures, they discover real-world consequences for their dreams.

videos.title: Dream Chasers
videos.overview: Mateo and Izzie free Cooper only to need a rescue of their own. During the battle, Mateo wakes up and brings a nightmare back with him to Brooklyn.

videos.title: Chased Dreamers
videos.overview: Mateo and his friends must defeat a giant sand guardian and enter the Dream Forge before the Grimions destroy it, but when there’s a dreamer in need, the kids must choose.

videos.title: The Dream Forge
videos.overview: Mateo and his friends enlist the help of Zoey and her abilities to manipulate time. Mr. Oz and Albert defend the forge from a nightmare storm while the kids enter the forge and face their greatest fears.

videos.title: Peak Performance
videos.overview: The search for the Sandman leads the Dream Chasers to Pillows Peak, but the Nightmare King is alerted to their ocation and begins an assault on the mountain.

videos.title: The Anomaly
videos.overview: A surprise visit from the Chief Inspector of the Night Bureau forces Mateo to hide Z-Blob, who goes on an adventure in the heart of Brooklyn.

videos.title: Cheat Code
videos.overview: Competing over who can ask Zoey to join their Sheep Week team, Logan cheats and unwittingly endangers the video game-based Cyber Realm.

videos.title: The Bigger Picture
videos.overview: When the kids meddle in their teacher's dream to find test answers, they realize that in dreams, sweet little Ms. Putnam isn't so sweet or little.

videos.title: Short Sheeped
videos.overview: Logan's desperation to prove himself leads to his capture by the Nightmare King, which leaves his friends to face the Sheep Week finals alone.

videos.title: The Grim Escape
videos.overview: The Dream Chasers rush to save Logan from the Shadowkeep's dungeon, but the liberators soon become the prisoners in a nightmarish twist of fate.

videos.title: Dreamer's Block
videos.overview: A mysterious dome blocks Mateo and the others from leaving their dream landing, and Zoey and Albert are their only hope of escape.

videos.title: Monkey and the Bandit
videos.overview: With Albert captured by the Night Hunter and Z-Blob detained by Agent Strick, it's time for a dual rescue in the Waking World and the Dream World.

videos.title: Private Eye
videos.overview: Detective Izzie takes the case of Mateo's missing comic book while Nova, the head of the Insomniacs, probes into a mystery of her own.

videos.title: Songs of the Mist
videos.overview: The hunt for the Sandman, the only one who can repair Lunia's hourglass, brings the kids to the dangerous Murky Realm, where memories go to die.

videos.title: Sweet Dreams
videos.overview: Determined to give the Insomniac's a night of good dreams, Izzie and friends bring them to the Candy Realm; but nowhere is safe from Nightmare King.

videos.title: The Worthy Dreamer
videos.overview: The Dream Chasers arrive at Castle Nocturnia hoping to find the key to defeating the Nightmare King, but the castle won't reveal its secrets easily.

videos.title: The Light of Nocturnia
videos.overview: The Dream Chasers rush to crack the code to reveal Lunia's secrets while the Nightmare King presses a full-scale assault on Castle Nocturnia.

videos.title: Night Hunted
videos.overview: The Nightmare King begins to open a rift to the Waking World while Mateo presses Oz for the truth about Lunia's battle with the Nightmare King.

videos.title: The Rift
videos.overview: A night terror is on the hunt at the fall festival and so is the Night Hunter, who appears in the Waking World with a brand-new threat for Mateo.

videos.title: Enter the Nightmare
videos.overview: The barrier to the Waking World has been torn and the Nightmare King invades Brooklyn, where the Dream Chasers must make their final stand.

videos.title: Sheep Freak
videos.overview: Missing Z-Blob, Mateo tries to free him to the neglect of his dream chaser duties while the team wrestles with an incursion case and a flock of unusual ravens ignites Izzie's suspicions.

videos.title: Memory Chasers
videos.overview: Oz takes the dream chasers to Castle Nocturnia to meet Grand Inspector Royce. Zoey heads to the Grim Realm to confront the Night Hunter and the rest of the team consults the enigmatic Sandman.

videos.title: Sound of Sirens
videos.overview: When the Murky Realm disappears, a student's intense daydream results in dangerous sirens and the dream chasers must keep hapless students and teachers safe as Mateo faces pressure to meet his dad's new girlfriend.

videos.title: Sick Beats
videos.overview: Logan wants to prove himself as a serious musician to Zoey while Mateo suspects Jasmine is working with the Never Witch.

videos.title: Witchy Ways
videos.overview: The dream chasers go after their missing memories and the dream chasers try find the Never Witch's hide-out while Phil covers for them at Castle Nocturnia.

videos.title: Toss and Turn
videos.overview: With realms going missing, the dream chasers want to skip training for R.E.M. trials while Zoey's haunted by her most painful memories and Mateo continues to only dream craft Z-Blob-related items.

videos.title: Romancing the Spear
videos.overview: Set in the past, the dream chaser duo Hannah and Beau argue while young Oz searches for Lunia.

videos.title: Beat the Clock
videos.overview: Zoey tries to rebuild a relationship with her estranged dad and Logan steps up his training to beat Astrid.

videos.title: Wake That Dreamer
videos.overview: A close call with the Never Witch places Mateo in the forests of Wildoria while Beau is on an adventure in the dream world with Zoey.

videos.title: Tale of Two Teos
videos.overview: Zoey and Mateo are trapped in the Grim Realm while Izzie is suspicious of MadTeo's true identity.

videos.title: Adventures in Robot-Sitting
videos.overview: An attack by the Never Witch draws the dream chasers to the Dunes of Duralumina, leaving Nova and Sneak to handle an incursion on their own.

videos.title: Personal Space Invaders
videos.overview: Attempting to track the Never Witch using Oz's powerful telescope, the booby traps surprise the dream chasers at Oz and Albert's landing.

videos.title: Fistful of Doppelgangers
videos.overview: Fearing for the fate of the Candy Realm, the dream chasers evacuate its inhabitants while Mateo and Astrid infiltrate the Midnight Raven.

videos.title: Irrational Treasure
videos.overview: When the dream chasers discover the eye of confusion's location, it kicks off a treasure hunt with the Never Witch's doppelgangers in hot pursuit.

videos.title: Mission Implausible
videos.overview: Logan and Astrid face their fears in the dream forge while Mateo, Zoey, and Z-Blob seek out the gnorfs to destroy the eye of confusion.

videos.title: Grim Vengeance
videos.overview: When the Never Witch sets her sights on the Grim Realm, the dream chasers must team up with the Nightmare King and grim spawn to stop her.

videos.title: Crown Control
videos.overview: The team find the Crown of Control quite easily when they meet the King of the Creatures, but they realise that extracting it back to Brooklyn is much harder.

videos.title: The Promised Crown Affair
videos.overview: While Izzie faces off against the King of the Creatures in the dream world, the dream chasers keep Izzie's disappearance a secret in the waking world.

videos.title: Now or Never Witch
videos.overview: The Never Witch creates a doppel monster to eliminate the dream chasers once and for all as she casts her master spell to undo the dream world.

videos.title: Never Forever
videos.overview: With the dream world disintegrating and the Never Witch's spell nearing completion, the dream chasers face impossible odds aboard the Midnight Raven.

videos.title: Everything's Changed
videos.overview: The company Happy App and a new hero arrive in town. Later, Mateo helps Sneak get rid of a creepy cake in the Grim Realm.

videos.title: Join the Club
videos.overview: After a fight about the Dream Smasher, Z-Blob and Mateo each try to find new friends in the Dream World and Waking World.

videos.title: Whack Race 2025
videos.overview: Zoey and Mateo race to decide who's the fastest delivery rider only to realize their old Dream World enemy, Claudius, works at Happy App.

videos.title: Dreamocracy
videos.overview: Dream Smasher's popularity continues to grow, and Izzie tries to join his team as a sidekick — leaving Mateo and the Dream Chasers behind.

videos.title: Freak-quencies
videos.overview: After a dangerous night in the Dream World, Mateo and Zoey go to find Claudius at Happy App HQ and learn he's been promoted.

videos.title: InterFEARence
videos.overview: Stranded and separated in a dangerous dream space, the gang must find a way to wake up. Meanwhile, Dr. Oswald confronts an old friend.

videos.title: Lunia
videos.overview: In the Waking World, Mateo, Izzie and the Dream Chasers rush to learn about the origins of Lunia's amazing powers.

videos.title: Moving On Top
videos.overview: Mateo and Izzie try to trick Claudius into spilling the details of his plan while Happy App takes over the school.

videos.title: Brainstorm
videos.overview: Dr. Oswald and the team devise a plan to get inside the Dream Smasher's hideout, which he believes is inside the Dream World's mysterious new sun.

videos.title: Boxed In
videos.overview: Stuck in Dream Smasher's brain base, Mateo and Z-Blob bust out of prison to track down their pals and the hourglass before it's too late.

videos.title: The Happy App Trap
videos.overview: The Berlin Bright Bureau receives a mysterious package with new goggles to help them become more efficient dream chasers, but at what cost?

videos.title: Mission: Ungoggle-Able
videos.overview: Mateo, Izzie, Zoey, and Cooper are unwilling participants in a sleep study at Happy App Headquarters, and it's up to the others to break them out!

videos.title: D-Shock
videos.overview: The gang flees to the wilds of Central Park where they plan their next move against the Brain, and also receive an unexpected visitor.

videos.title: Robot Fight Club
videos.overview: When our heroes infiltrate the Happy App building to disrupt production they find themselves thrust into a robot fight club where they must compete!

videos.title: Fish Out of Water
videos.overview: As the team goes to investigate an area of the dream world that scares the Brain, Zoey falls into a strange dimension and an even stranger adventure.

videos.title: Cyber Drain
videos.overview: After playing a video game that mimics their lives, the dream chasers visit the Cyber Realm to learn how to beat the final boss and defeat Happy App.

videos.title: School Spirit
videos.overview: Nova sends out an S.O.S. that has the dream chasers rushing to her rescue and straight into a trap!

videos.title: The Undreamt
videos.overview: Our heroes have no choice but to ask The Undreamt to help them in their fight against D-Shock and the Happy App.

videos.title: Missing Pieces
videos.overview: Working with the dangerous UNDREAMT, our heroes must use its creative chaotic energy to try and bring life back to the unsaturated dream world.

videos.title: Outside the Box
videos.overview: Dream chasers are faced with the Brain's Final Protocol, to box the dream world for all of eternity.
